description.zh:
数据导出的配置。是一个JSONObject字符串。必须要包含如下字段：

- endpoint：日志服务（SLS）数据对应的域名。
- project：项目。
- logstore：日志库。
- ak：AccessKey ID。
- as：AccessKey Secret。
description.en:
The configuration of the data export. The value is a JSONObject string that must contain the following fields:

- endpoint: the domain name that corresponds to the data of Log Service (SLS).
- project: the project.
- logstore: the Logstore.
- ak: the AccessKey ID.
- as: the AccessKey secret.
The product to which the data is exported.

title.zh: 创建或者修改一个监控数据导出配置
title.en: Create or modify a monitoring data export configuration

descriptions.zh: > 目前仅支持日志服务（SLS），后续将支持导出更多的产品。
descriptions.en: > Only Log Service (SLS) is supported. More products will be supported in the future.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms put-exporter-output --dest-name exporterConfig --config-json endpoint_:_http://cn-qingdao-share.log.aliyuncs.com_,_project_:_exporter_,_logstore_:_exporter_,_ak_:_LTAIp0000000_,_userId_:_1775400000000_,_as_:_TxHwuJ8yAb3AU000000 --desc CPU_metric_export --dest-type sls --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms PutExporterOutput --region cn-hangzhou --Desc CPU_metric_export --DestType sls --DestName exporterConfig --ConfigJson 'endpoint_:_http://cn-qingdao-share.log.aliyuncs.com_,_project_:_exporter_,_logstore_:_exporter_,_ak_:_LTAIp0000000_,_userId_:_1775400000000_,_as_:_TxHwuJ8yAb3AU000000'
